title: Run distillate
description: The bounded hand-off one delegated run returns (WORKFLOW.md §6.2), as JSON. One shape for every runtime: a Claude subagent writes it in prose, a Codex run returns it as its final message under --output-schema, and tools/run-codex.mjs merges the tree-derived fields in. Strict-mode safe: every object sets additionalProperties:false and lists every property in required; fields that may be absent are nullable unions, never omitted.

status.description: done = the brief is built and its gates are green; blocked = something needs an owner decision; failed = the run did not produce a usable result.

summary.description: Three lines at most, plain words (the plain-report skill): what changed and what it means.

changed_paths.description: Repository-relative paths the run touched. The adapter overwrites this from `git status --porcelain` in --cwd: the tree is the truth, not the model's claim.

gates.description: Every gate the run actually executed, with its verdict.

name.description: The command as run, e.g. `node tools/lint.mjs`.

first_error.description: First failing line when red, else null. Never the whole log.

deviations.description: References to what departed from the brief (a line, a path, a decision id) — not the content of the change.

next.description: What still needs an independent reviewer, a manual check, or a following session.

blocked_reason.description: Required when status is blocked: the decision the owner has to make, in one sentence. Null otherwise.

runtime.description: Which runtime produced this distillate. The orchestrator prints `runtime · model · tokens` on the handoff line.

effort.description: Reasoning effort the run was launched with (`low`, `medium`, `high`), or an empty string when the runtime has no such dial.

thread_id.description: Session id a corrective retry resumes from. Null when the runtime did not report one.

usage.description: Token counts from the runtime's event stream. Null when the runtime reported none.

high_impact_touched.description: Intersection of changed_paths with the §10 High-impact files row — the docs-reminder hook's job, done by the adapter because plugin hooks do not fire inside another runtime. Null when the adapter could not read the profile.
